content: हुम् {%ind.%} A particle (originally an imitative sound) expressing .²1 Remembrance or recollection; हुं ज्ञातम् or रामो नाम बभूव हुं तदबला सीतेति हुम्. .²2 Doubt; चैत्रो हुं मैत्रो हुम्. .²3 Assent; <ls>U. 5. 35</ls>. .²4 Anger. .²5 Aversion. .²6 Reproach. .²7 Interrogation. (In spells and incantations हुम् is often found used with <ab>dat.</ab>; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} ओं कवचाय हुम्). (हुंकृ means ‘to utter the sound {%hum%}’, ‘to roar, grunt, bellow’, as in अनुहुंकृ ‘to roar in return’; अनुहुंकुरुते घनध्वनिं न हि गोमायुरुतानि केसरी <ls>Śi. 16. 25.</ls>).
